title: 第2033章 陆玄无解第2032章 陆玄星域之神
slug: 我的徒弟们都太逆天了
lines: 幽林长老等人惨叫了起来。
这种痛苦他们从来没有体会过。
不是肉身成名，不是神魂层面，而是无法描述！
砰砰砰！
星空之中，一道道痛苦惨叫的身影坠落了下来，他们将死，但还没有完全死掉。
除了痛苦之外，还有无尽的恐惧！
陆玄这究竟是什么手段？
狠人女帝美眸闪烁。
她看出来了。
这是星域规则层面的抹除。
而这时。
众多轮回军突然大吼了起来，“杀！杀啊！”
狠人女帝没有阻止！
浩浩荡荡的大军直接冲杀了过去。
众人祭出灵兵，向着那些惨叫的诡族疯狂发泄。
“轰轰轰！”
一道道尸体从空中坠落了下来。
完全是屠杀！
这时，叶霜长老突然一愣，从怀中取出一个玉佩。
玉佩在闪烁。
她微微一笑很倾城，“是杜菲凌长老。”
“我正在过来，很快到山鼎界了。”
杜菲凌柔和平静的声音响起。
叶霜长老马上告诉了陆玄。
陆玄淡淡点头，“好。”
他拍了拍手，躺在了躺椅上休息了起来。
其他的交给狠人女帝她们了。
小囡囡则是趴在陆玄的大腿上，也眯起了眼睛。
而在远处，璇玑圣主和噬魂长老等人回头只是看了一眼，就震惊在原地。
“太恐怖了！”
他们被莫名的惊悚笼罩全身。
“快走！”
噬魂长老突然惊叫了起来。
陆玄的这股力量对诡族是无差别攻击的！
覆盖整个大昌星域。
他们也被锁定了！
“陆玄已经得到了天地意志！”
噬魂长老脸上抽搐了起来，“难道我们都要死在这里吗？”
他吓得直接燃魂，疯狂的撕裂虚空，想要挪移离开！
就连璇玑圣主也感到一股莫名的杀机。
那是一种恶意！
content_en:
;;
"Ah!"
Elder Youlin and others screamed.
They have never experienced this kind of pain.
It’s not about becoming famous physically, it’s not about the spiritual level, it’s about being indescribable!
Bang bang bang!
In the starry sky, figures screaming in pain fell down. They were about to die, but not completely dead yet.
In addition to pain, there is endless fear!
What exactly is Lu Xuan's method?
The beautiful eyes of the ruthless empress flashed.
She saw it.
This is an erasure at the level of star domain rules.
And this time.
Many reincarnation troops suddenly shouted, "Kill! Kill!"
The ruthless empress didn't stop her!
The mighty army rushed directly towards them.
Everyone sacrificed their spiritual soldiers and vented their anger towards the screaming Kuai tribe.
"Boom boom boom!"
Lines of corpses fell from the sky.
Total massacre!
At this time, Elder Ye Shuang was suddenly stunned and took out a jade pendant from his arms.
The jade pendant is flashing.
She smiled charmingly and said, "It's Elder Du Feiling."
"I'm coming over. I'll be at Shanding Realm soon."
Du Feiling's soft and calm voice sounded.
Elder Ye Shuang immediately told Lu Xuan.
Lu Xuan nodded lightly, "Okay."
He clapped his hands and lay down on the lounge chair to rest.
Leave the rest to the ruthless empress and the others.
The little girl lay on Lu Xuan's lap and narrowed her eyes.
In the distance, Holy Lord Xuanji, Soul-Eating Elder and others looked back and were shocked.
"It's so scary!"
They were enveloped in inexplicable horror.
"Let's go!"
The soul-eating elder suddenly screamed.
Lu Xuan's power attacks the Kuai clan indiscriminately!
Covering the entire Dachang Star Territory.
They are also locked!
"Lu Xuan has obtained the will of heaven and earth!"
Elder Soul Eater's face twitched, "Are we all going to die here?"
He was so frightened that he burned his soul, tearing the void crazily, trying to move away!
Even Holy Lord Xuanji felt an inexplicable murderous intention.
That's a kind of malice!
title_en: Chapter 2033 Lu Xuan has no solution Chapter 2032 Lu Xuan is the God of Star Territory
